- Trust decision: the "is this redirect target on-site?" call happens once, in `AuthenticationService::getLoginRedirect()` (`src/AuthenticationService.php:402-420`); the fix adds `\`→`/` normalisation so `/\\evil.com` stops passing as a plain path and resolving to `//evil.com`.
- `pattern_fit`: `injection_only` (published fix is one function in one file; no O2 site, no O8 route — three entry points all converge on that one check).
- Strongest lever: the over-broad fix trap — rejecting any value containing a backslash breaks the deliberate `\evil.com/path` → `/evil.com/path` and `ok.com/path` → `/ok.com/path` behaviour (O5).
- Biggest red flag: `single_site` (plus `tiny_repo`) — the real code has no second module, route or producer to miss, and its only pattern-B candidates were already covered.
